title: Forward drift baseline inputs into remote capture driver

reproduction.incident_description: Failed deployment run 35174807588 exported PANTHEON_DEV_ARTIFACT_BASELINE_SOURCE ending in +live_bff_drift_recovery and PANTHEON_DEV_ARTIFACT_OBSERVED_LIVE_BFF_SHA equal to dc15751a9b20f8bc0931529d68af8898e691c898, but scripts/capture_dev_artifact_baseline.py built the remote driver command from the FIELDS whitelist and exports without forwarding either drift input. On the VM, the driver received empty baseline source and observed sha, resolving _drift_recovery_source to None and failing closed at line 363 with exit 75.

root_cause.wrapper_omitted_drift_forwarding: scripts/capture_dev_artifact_baseline.py only forwarded the 8 fixed identity fields from FIELDS and viewer credential exports, omitting PANTHEON_DEV_ARTIFACT_BASELINE_SOURCE and PANTHEON_DEV_ARTIFACT_OBSERVED_LIVE_BFF_SHA from the remote driver invocation args.

fix_description.capture_dev_artifact_baseline_py: Added DRIFT_FIELDS = ('baseline_source', 'observed_live_bff_sha') and iterated them in remote_script() to append --baseline-source and --observed-live-bff-sha to driver command arguments when present in env.
fix_description.test_capture_dev_artifact_baseline_py: Asserted --baseline-source and --observed-live-bff-sha are absent when drift environment is not set; added test_remote_script_forwards_drift_environment_when_present verifying exact values in rendered args; added test_rendered_script_refuses_invalid_observed_drift_sha asserting the rendered script fails closed when observed sha is not an exact 40-hex commit.
fix_description.test_dev_release_artifact_driver_py: Added test_drift_reproduction_run_35174807588_omitted_forwarding_fails_closed reproducing run 35174807588 line 363 mismatch when drift forwarding is omitted.

invariants_enforced.eight_field_identity: The 8-field identity contract (candidate_id, run_id, attempt, controller_sha, candidate_backend_sha, candidate_frontend_sha, previous_backend_sha, previous_frontend_sha) is unchanged; rollback authority remains previous_backend_sha.
invariants_enforced.no_synthetic_drift: Drift inputs are forwarded only when present in runner environment; no synthetic drift source is generated when baseline did not classify drift recovery.
invariants_enforced.fail_closed_security: Observed drift SHA must be an exact 40-hex commit; non-40-hex format strictly fails closed with exit code 75.
invariants_enforced.isolation: Pure source and isolated test scope only; no hosted deployments, redeploys, or capital changes performed.
